title: Chapter 693
paragraphs: Chapter 693
Episode 177. Yona, Yona, Yona......(2)
The party continued to move forward, following the traces of spirit energy.

"If it weren't for you... We might have been fooling around without being able to distinguish between the real and fake child. Now, we can't even be sure if what we first found in this forest was the real Yona."
Two types of spirit energy.
He couldn't be sure which one was the real Yona's. For now, he was confident he could suppress anyone, no matter how many they met, as long as they didn't join forces.
Even if they joined forces, it wouldn't be a problem at all once they perfectly distinguished between the real and the fake.
'If multiple fakes have entered the forest, it's probably to capture or... eliminate Yona.'
Then what Jin had to do was not only secure Yona, but also include her protection.
Owul was blaming himself for that point.
Mumei had conducted the operation without considering the existence of a fake Yona.
"It's difficult to predict that there might be a fake in the forest. The place where Yona was found is unique to Akin."
Jin read his mind and spoke.
"Even after I clearly heard that the traces of chaos left by Yona after I met you at Hyran's second star are used to create the fake, I made such a mistake. I have no face to see that child."
"Owul, don't overcomplicate your thoughts. Anyway, there are two types of spirit energy, and none of their owners have left the forest yet. We just need to resolve this from now on."
At least three, maybe more than five.
The traces of Yona's chaos missed by Mumei so far were roughly that much.
Jin thought there might be more than ten fakes in the forest, assuming the worst-case scenario.
Even so, he thought he could handle it with his current power.
"We need to speed up. I have a hunch that the fakes are targeting my sister. Hmm... Let's start with a simple approach. Both of you better cover your ears."
Whew...!
Jin took a deep breath.
Yona, sister-!
As soon as Jin shouted with all his might, the trees in front of him broke and uprooted due to the wind pressure.
The echo rang throughout the forest as if an earthquake had occurred.
If there were ordinary people standing next to him instead of Hedo and Owul, they would have passed out with their eardrums burst.
"You've got a good voice. If your sister is in the forest, she must have heard it."

"Thank you, Hedo. Owul, if you were somewhere in the forest ahead right now and heard my voice, how would you come? If you need to verify my location. Whether to attempt an assassination or to observe movements."
Owul immediately understood his words.
"You mean to observe the Yonas' movement routes, follow me."
Instead of carefully and slowly chasing the spirit energy as before, the party sprinted after Owul.
Owul moved fittingly for his title of the Unnamed King, his speed weaving between the trees was nearly the same as Jin and Hedo running in a straight line.
Above all, Owul made almost no noise while moving. As if it were not a person running, but the wind.
"Truly the Unnamed King. Is your sister, the assassin, even more impressive than me?"
"Probably. I heard that she surpassed you in assassination a long time ago. I've never heard the sound of her footsteps."
While they were running, Owul suddenly stopped.
This time, he was the first to notice a hint of energy that others could not read.
"It's murderous intent."
At those words, Jin and Hedo also sensed the faint murderous intent.
Whether it's real or fake. One of them has clearly become much closer due to the movement just now.
Jin read the remaining spirit energy nearby again.
"There's much stronger spirit energy left than before. Still two types, meaning both the real sister and the fake responded to my voice."
Boom!
As soon as he finished speaking, a red flare shot up from the other side of the forest. Yona had appeared from one side of the encirclement.
Jin also fired a flare. It was a yellow signal flare, indicating abnormal situation.
At the same time, golden energy soared into the sky. It was the flight of Veil. He quickly headed to the place where the red flare had exploded and then flew back to Jin. His face full of annoyance.
"Veil, did you see sister Yona where the red flare just went off?"
[I didn't see her. She just made a surprise attack and then disappeared. I was about to search around there, but why did you suddenly call me?]
"Surprise attack? Any casualties?"
[A guy named Kel got hurt, just a little cut.]
"Thank goodness. There are fake Yonas mixed in the forest."
[What? It's not just one?]

"Notify the rest of the personnel about this fact, and if you see a Yona, real or fake, immediately subdue and bring them to me. Remember, do not kill or cripple them. Capture them unharmed. If it's impossible to do so alone, track while firing a flare, and avoid causing harm to the encirclement personnel."
[Then I'll start by chasing the one who attacked Kel... Oh, what's that!]
Boom, Boom!
Unfortunately, Veil didn't have time for that.
From that point on, signal flares began to be fired in all directions.
"Go check them all out and report the situation to Jin, Veil."
[Uh... Got it!]
Veil replied as he soared into the sky.
Using his transcendental flight abilities, he was able to execute real-time communication superbly.
[I spotted your sister over there, Lanke drove her off.]
[Two appeared at once over there, they ran away immediately when Bianca engaged them...]
[I just encountered one, and inflicted a minor wound during the chase. Don't worry, it wasn't fatal! I only grazed the arm so it can be distinguished from the other Yonas.]
Like a broadcast center, Veil performed his role of real-time communication wonderfully. If not for him, all the search teams would have been in great confusion.
Lanke and Bianca, as expected, played significant roles. If Jin hadn't brought all of them, there would have been casualties by now.
As Veil reported, Owl marked all Yonas' positions on the map and pondered their predicted routes, while Jin didn't let his concentration falter in distinguishing the two types of spirit energies.
The two could fully immerse themselves in their tasks from time to time because of Hedo.
Soon, Owl narrowed down the most probable routes of the Yonas, and Jin perfectly distinguished the spirit energies.

"I am certain, Owl. The energy of the real sister is singular, while the energies of the fakes are identical and overlap. The overlapped ones are the fake energies. There are a total of three fakes in this vicinity."
That was why Jin had been focusing on distinguishing spirit energies after entering the forest.
He needed to determine which type of energy was unique, and through the overlapping energies, he also needed to estimate the number of fakes.
"In addition, as my sister's energy is getting stronger, all those discovered in other encirclement lines are likely to be fakes due to the timing."
In other words, the real Yona was currently the closest to their group, along with the three fake Yonas.
"That narrows down the possible routes to one or two, 12th generation."
The routes Owl had in mind were precisely that.
Whether the fakes were driving the real Yona to kill her, or the other way around, Owl was now certain that they would encounter the Yonas soon.
This was because, with each of Veil's reports, the Yonas in the encirclement lines were moving further into the forest, as if narrowing the net towards their prey.
"The fakes must be trying to gather in the center of the forest while causing disturbances because of us. But there's one thing that's strange."
"What's strange?"
"The real Yona undoubtedly has superior abilities than the fakes. She should have taken down at least one of them by now, but there's no trace of that."
"So you're saying that Sister Yona is only fleeing."
"Either Yona is unable to use her abilities properly, or there's another interfering factor."
"We should head to the center of the forest first, King without a Name."
There were no signs of battle by the time they reached the center of the forest. Instead, the group started being attacked from then on.
Suddenly, a chill crept up their backs, and when they turned, a knife was thrown at them. The moment they tried to block it, the image of Yona vanished from their sight.
After defending against the first, second, and third attacks, Jin reached a conclusion.
"...The one attacking us now is the real Sister Yona. Her spirit energy doesn't overlap with the other energies."
It took three times because he could only confirm it in the moment of evading the attack.
"In addition, the other fakes are also nearby. Their spirit energies are constantly tangled and moving... that's one way to differentiate them from the real sister."
"They're nearby?"

"Yes, and the killing intent we sensed earlier also came from the fakes. Based on the attacks we're experiencing now, the real Sister Yona... doesn't even leave such a faint trace of killing intent. Even the residual spirit energy that she can't help leaving, would be unrecognizable to anyone but me."
Jin looked around with a complicated expression.
In essence, Jin and Owl's assumptions were wrong.
The fakes weren't moving to eliminate Yona, and the real Yona wasn't running from them.
What the real and fake Yonas were aiming for, from the beginning, was Jin's group. In fact, they had been moving together since the Nameless King confirmed Yona's whereabouts in Akin.
From then on, the real and fake Yonas alternately moved in such a way as to deliberately make the Nameless King recognize them as 'one person', so it was natural for Owl not to consider the fakes.
"So Yona wasn't unable to defeat the fakes, but was cooperating with them from the start..."
The moment Owl spoke those words, the forest landscape they were watching distorted rapidly.
This was the activation of the 'trap' set by the Yonas.
A dark curtain shot up from all sides, and Jin immediately recognized that it was the void of chaos.
The three drew their swords back-to-back.
Then, from within the darkness, a completely unexpected voice echoed out.
[Jin... it's been a long time.]
Joshua Luncandel.
It was his voice.
